thread:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: route /v1/generate error spike in eu-west-1 — 5xx rate 12% (baseline 0.2%). Pager routed to oncall.

alex: I'm on EU primary tonight but hit a family emergency. I can hand off but need someone to pick up asap. Sorry :disappointed:.

maria: @alex thanks for flagging. Do we have an active pager incident? I see the alert but no bridge yet.

sre-bot: Bridge created — https://bridges.redwood.example/incident/3141592653
Alert details: cpu 72%, pod restarts 3, nginx upstream 502s.

jamal: I'll take primary for the next 2h. Deeply in transit but can be on phone. Primary -> jamal, secondary -> connie. I'll start triage.

connie: Ok I'll be secondary and shadow. Jamal, if you need escalation to eng-platform ping me and I'll join greenroom.

jamal: Thanks. First step: check canary rollout status and recent deploys. From runbook: https://wiki.redwood.example/runbooks/ingress-5xx

leo: FYI, customer impact table shows 3 customers with degraded requests: acme-inc, blueocean, textify — most traffic from eu-west-1

jamal: Running quick queries:
```
# check recent deploys
kubectl -n prod get rs -l app=redwood-ingress --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 5
# error rates
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=redwood-ingress --since=30m | grep "502" | wc -l
```

alex: echoing runbook steps — try rollback of recent canary if matching timestamp: deploy-v2.3.1-2026-03-15

jamal: I see a canary at 02:11 UTC that correlates. I'm going to pause the canary and scale down the canary replicas.

jamal: paused canary via console, scaled canary to 0. Watching metrics.

sre-bot: Automated action: Traffic reroute initiated to eu-central fallback for 15m as per policy.

maria: Noted. Jamal, can you confirm whether KV cache warmers are running? Past incidents showed cache misses spike causing 502s.

jamal: Good catch — cache miss rate is elevated. Running warmers:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/cache/warm?region=eu-west-1
```

jamal: Miss rate improving, 5xx dropping to 3.1% — still elevated but moving in right direction.

connie: Logging the customer impact and ETA in the incident tracker. jamal — please note if you need to route specific customers to dedicated capacity.

jamal: For now no dedicated routing. If we see >5% for 15m, we'll open dedicated pool and route acme-inc.

alex: Thanks all — heading offline. Jamal, connie take it over. If anything blocks escalate to eng-platform.

jamal: Will do. I'll update every 10m and send a final handoff when I'm handing back.

sre-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial. 5xx 1.2% after 25m. ongoing watch period 30m.

leo: thx team. I'll monitor customer support mentions and update CS.

connie: Shadowing and available.

jamal: Handing back at 03:05 UTC to alex (offline). primary -> alex, secondary -> connie. Closing bridge in 15m unless new alerts.

maria: Nice work, quick mitigations. Please add a short post-incident note about the canary gating and cache warmer gaps.

jamal: will add to tracker.

connie: :thumbsup:
